# iru_behavioral_detections_v2 (Data Source)

List behavioral detection events using the v2 API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iru_behavioral_detections_v2" "example" {
  statuses = ["informational", "detected"]
}

output "detection_descriptions" {
  value = [for r in data.iru_behavioral_detections_v2.example.results : r.description]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (String) Filter by device UUID.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of results to return.
- `management_state` (String) Filter by management state.
- `offset` (Number) Number of results to skip.
- `severities` (List of String) Filter by severity.
- `statuses` (List of String) Filter by threat status (e.g., `informational`, `detected`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
